author: Microsoft
name: macOS XPC Service
description: A project for creating a bundled XPC service for a .NET macOS application
postActions/addProjectReference/descript: Reference the service and its protocol from the containing macOS app
postActions/addProjectReference/manualIn:
Add these references to the containing macOS app, adjusting the paths:

<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="macOSXpcService1.csproj" IsAppExtension="true" />
  <ProjectReference Include="Contracts/Contracts.csproj" />
</ItemGroup>

Set Registrar=trimmable-static in the host project so XPC reply block signatures are available.
Connect using NSXpcConnection with the service's ApplicationId.
The service is embedded in Contents/XPCServices, not PlugIns.
symbols/bundleId/description: The bundle identifier of the containing macOS application
symbols/minOSVersion/description: Overrides SupportedOSPlatformVersion in the project files
symbols/Framework/description: The target framework for the projects.
